investment_strategy: Cautiously overweight secular A.I. leaders with strong fundamentals and positive revisions, while sizing risk to a moderate level given a VIX ~16 and a higher-for-longer 10Y yield (~4.6%). Emphasize quality mega-cap platforms and critical chip suppliers tied to the data-center capex boom, with controlled exposure to higher-volatility names. Monitor regulatory/antitrust actions, export controls, and power constraints that may influence dispersion across Big Tech and semiconductors.

final_recommendations.news_factor: Enterprise A.I. monetization at scale (copilots, Azure), OpenAI partnership leverage, and proactive stance on A.I. governance; securing power for data centers.
final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Core, lower-volatility compounder with strong earnings/revenue growth and consistent beats; benefits directly from enterprise A.I. spend. Suits a moderate-risk tilt in a 4.6% yield environment.

final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Strong growth, fast momentum, and broad A.I. optionality across Search, YouTube, and Cloud. Slightly below MSFT weight due to antitrust headline risk and higher beta.

final_recommendations.news_factor: Chokepoint lithography supplier amid export controls; central to advanced node capacity and the data-center chip build-out.
final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Best-in-class upstream exposure to A.I. semiconductor demand with structural pricing power; balanced to a mid-teens weight to respect policy/export-control volatility.

final_recommendations.news_factor: Dominant A.I. compute supplier; sustained demand-supply tightness; U.S.-China policy sensitivity and power constraints are watch items.
final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Secular A.I. leader with bullish trend and repeated beats; position sized below platforms to cap portfolio volatility and policy risk.

final_recommendations.news_factor: On-device/edge A.I. (Apple Intelligence) to activate a massive installed base; potential uplift to device replacement cycle and services attach.
final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Defensive mega-cap within tech with strong cash generation; included for edge A.I. optionality despite slower momentum and a bearish near-term trend.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: A.I. infrastructure and platform leaders with strong earnings momentum and durable moats, balanced for policy, antitrust, and power-supply risks.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility where available, strong earnings/revenue growth, positive analyst consensus (BUY/STRONG_BUY), and demonstrated momentum; incorporated news themes (A.I. platform race, semiconductor chokepoints, power constraints, and regulation) and macro context (VIX ~16, 10Y ~4.6%) to size allocations.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Cautiously optimistic on technology: secular A.I. demand supports semiconductors and cloud platforms amid ongoing data-center capex expansion. Key risks include higher-for-longer rates, export controls/geopolitics, antitrust scrutiny, and energy availability for A.I. data centers. Expect continued leadership from quality mega-caps and critical chip suppliers, with dispersion around regulatory outcomes and supply bottlenecks.
